Buying Treasury bonds: What you need to know now | Fidelity Investments
s: April 30, 2025 - If you’ve decided that you want Treasurys, your next decision may be what kind of Treasurys. You can choose from 3 types: Notes, bonds, and bills. Notes and bonds differ only in name and in the length of time before you get your money back. Notes are available with maturities ranging from 1 to 10 years while bonds can have maturities of as long as 30 years. Both pay you interest every 6 months at a rate that is set at the time you buy the bond.
